steps.command: sqlite3 -header -column /Users/roberthyatt/.claude/ironclaude-workspaces.db "SELECT 'assignments' AS tbl, * FROM assignments WHERE workspace_guid='082b7cb0-e725-4064-8355-2495b1eb3877'; SELECT 'primary_checkout_owners' AS tbl, * FROM primary_checkout_owners WHERE workspace_guid='082b7cb0-e725-4064-8355-2495b1eb3877'; SELECT 'integration_locks' AS tbl, * FROM integration_locks WHERE workspace_guid='082b7cb0-e725-4064-8355-2495b1eb3877'; SELECT 'integration_records' AS tbl, * FROM integration_records WHERE workspace_guid='082b7cb0-e725-4064-8355-2495b1eb3877'; SELECT 'human_intents' AS tbl, * FROM human_intents WHERE workspace_guid='082b7cb0-e725-4064-8355-2495b1eb3877';"

steps.description: Step 2 — backup the DB before any delete.
